short.pt: A versão turbo do Qwen-Image 2.1: mesma qualidade, 2,4x mais rápida

summary.pt: O template oficial `image_qwen_image_2_1_turbo_t2i` com o modelo turbo em INT8 da Comfy-Org. Reaproveita o text encoder e o VAE do Qwen-Image 2.1. O ramo opcional que reescreve o prompt com o Qwen3.5 9B (desligado no template) foi removido.
summary.en: The official `image_qwen_image_2_1_turbo_t2i` template with Comfy-Org's INT8 turbo model. Reuses the Qwen-Image 2.1 text encoder and VAE. The optional branch that rewrites the prompt with Qwen3.5 9B (off in the template) was removed.

what.pt: Prompt do teste (igual nos modelos de imagem da comparação): café-livraria com um gato tricolor e uma placa escrita "OPEN DAILY 8-20", seed 20261022, 1024x1024.
what.en: Test prompt (same for every image model compared): bookstore café with a calico cat and a sign reading "OPEN DAILY 8-20", seed 20261022, 1024x1024.

usage.pt:
1. Prompt no nó de texto; resolução no **ResolutionSelector**.
2. Para reativar o reescritor de prompt do template original, baixe `qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_t2i.int8_convrot.safetensors` (Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1) e use o template do ComfyUI.
usage.en:
1. Prompt in the text node; resolution in **ResolutionSelector**.
2. To bring back the original template's prompt rewriter, download `qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_t2i.int8_convrot.safetensors` (Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1) and use the ComfyUI template.

notes.pt: Comparação na mesma seed/prompt (RTX 5060 Ti): Qwen 2.1 24 s · Qwen 2.1 Turbo 10 s · Krea 2 Turbo 23 s · Flux 3 Klein 21 s · MOSS-Image 35 s. Todos acertaram o texto da placa.
notes.en: Same seed/prompt comparison (RTX 5060 Ti): Qwen 2.1 24 s · Qwen 2.1 Turbo 10 s · Krea 2 Turbo 23 s · Flux 3 Klein 21 s · MOSS-Image 35 s. All rendered the sign text correctly.
